items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: The name 'James' refers to the interviewee's own name (Jimmy Jones), not a separate person.

ctx.x: Oh. And do people call you mostly Jimmy Jones, or there are some people that call you James Jones, aren't there?
My family, they say James. They don't accept the professional name. But everybody else says Jimmy. So consequently, you know, I've gotten adjusted to both.
